formula_convention.notes: The paper uses annual Compustat accounting data lagged by six months. Portfolio factors are rebalanced annually at the end of June and monthly returns are observed from July 1963 through December 2014. Fama-MacBeth regressions recompute explanatory variables monthly, but the main paper factor construction in Table 5 uses annual June portfolio formation.
